name: Shirley Daventry French
reason: Too thin: no personal website found (two web searches, 13 Nov 2026), and the Iyengar Yoga Centre of Victoria site she founded (iyengaryogacentre.ca, robots.txt open) has her biography page (https://iyengaryogacentre.ca/biographies/shirley-daventry-french/, with a usable headshot and the centre's email iyoga@telus.net) but names her in no current class, workshop, year-at-a-glance entry, store item or newsletter page, and the centre's YouTube channel (6 uploads, Data API 13 Nov 2026) has no video of her. Her only books named there are ones she edited (IYENGAR: His Life and Work; co-editor of Light on the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali), not authored. That leaves no listable items. She could be listed if the owner accepts a profile-only page, or later if the centre posts a programme she leads.
